title: Three $19.99 notebooks came to $59.94
body: A customer bought three notebooks at $19.99 each, and the order subtotal said $59.94. It should be $59.97. An order of $12.50 mugs the same day came out right, so it seems to depend on the price.

title: No free shipping on an order of exactly $50
body: The banner says orders of $50 or more ship free. A customer with exactly $50.00 in the cart, two $25 tote bags, was still charged $4.99 for shipping.

title: SAVE10 takes 10% off shipping too
body: On a $40.00 order with $4.99 shipping, the SAVE10 coupon gave a $4.50 discount. Coupons are only supposed to apply to the items, so it should be $4.00, for a total of $40.99.
